groups.title: Son Family
groups.def: Members of Goku's family by blood or marriage shown in the anime.

groups.title: Turtle School
groups.def: Martial artists trained under Master Roshi's Turtle School style shown in the anime.

groups.title: Ginyu Force
groups.def: The five members of Frieza's elite Ginyu Force special squadron.

groups.title: Namekians
groups.def: Characters of the Namekian race shown in the anime.

groups.title: Androids
groups.def: The numbered Androids built by Dr. Gero, including his own cyborg form (Android 20).

groups.title: Half-Saiyans
groups.def: Characters born of one Saiyan and one human parent shown in the anime (not fusion characters).

groups.title: Crane School
groups.def: Fighters trained under Master Shen's rival Crane School style shown in the anime.

groups.title: Universe 6
groups.def: Characters native to Universe 6 shown in the anime.

groups.title: Frieza Force
groups.def: Frieza's soldiers and family shown fighting for him during the Saiyan-to-Namek era of the anime (not Vegeta, who later defects to Earth).

groups.title: Red Ribbon Army
groups.def: Members, creations, and androids of the Red Ribbon Army (the original and its Capsule Corp-revived successor) shown in the anime.

groups.title: The Kais
groups.def: Deities of the Kai race, the guardians who serve below the Gods of Destruction, shown in the anime.

groups.title: Broly (2018) cast
groups.def: Principal characters introduced by the Dragon Ball Super: Broly (2018) film.

groups.title: Pride Troopers
groups.def: Universe 11's Pride Troopers who fought named, one-on-one battles on screen during the Tournament of Power.

groups.title: Gods of Destruction
groups.def: The twelve Gods of Destruction, one per universe, shown in the anime.

groups.title: Fusion characters
groups.def: Characters formed on-screen when two others fuse, by dance, Potara earrings, or otherwise.

groups.title: Time travelers
groups.def: Characters shown physically traveling between different timelines in the anime.

groups.title: Named after vegetables
groups.def: Full-blooded Saiyans whose names are puns on vegetables, per the wiki's own naming-convention note (King Vegeta included, since his name is literally Vegeta).

groups.title: Named after alcoholic drinks
groups.def: Gods of Destruction and Angels whose names pun on an alcoholic drink. Every God of Destruction's name does (beer, champagne, rum, gin, tequila, cider, liqueur, vermouth, wine, Hennessy, arak, moscato), plus the angels Whis (whisky) and Vados (calvados).
